Absolutely fantastic experience with PPSI. From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and well cared for. The nursing staff and Dr Jib have such a warm, professional, and reassuring bedside manner, which made the entire experience much more comfortable.

The facility is exceptionally clean, well-organised, and efficiently run. Every member of staff was accommodating, attentive, and genuinely committed to ensuring I was comfortable throughout my stay.

I am incredibly grateful for the care and support I received and would highly recommend PPSI to anyone considering their services.

I’m leaving this as a serious warning to anyone considering Phuket Plastic Surgery.

A very close friend of mine went through surgery connected with this hospital, and I have watched the aftermath devastate her, her partner and their family.

After the procedure, she became seriously unwell with shaking, muscle spasms, confusion, breathing issues and seizures. I was told by her family that when they repeatedly asked for help, they felt dismissed and unsupported while her condition continued to worsen.

She was later formally diagnosed with serotonin syndrome and has been left dealing with ongoing seizures, PTSD, chronic pain, neurological symptoms, weakness, trauma and major disruption to her ability to live and work the way she once did.

Over the past two years, I have had regular conversations with my best mate about the ongoing impact, the legal process, and the emotional and financial stress this has caused their family. What has stayed with me most is that a family very close to me has been devastated by this whole situation, and after everything they have been through, they have been left with nothing to show for it.

I’m not writing this lightly. I’m writing it because people need to be warned. Please do serious research, ask hard questions, get everything in writing, and think very carefully before putting your health in their hands.

Based on what I have seen, I would avoid Phuket Plastic Surgery if you can.

The surgeons might be amazing, but actually talking to them has proven impossible. If you end up talking to someone called "Jason" just ignore the email, start again and hope you get someone else.

After three months with replies from Jason a month apart and no useful information in any of them, he'd suddenly said I was due for male-to-female GRS in a couple weeks and my online consult with Dr.Singto (not the doctor I requested) only a couple of days away. That consult got cancelled a couple hours beforehand because Jason gave me the incomplete and incorrect payment information and part of the bits I had to find and fix myself was incorrect. The information he'd gave me was for partly bit from two separate banks, neither in Phuket, with an address for the transaction that was just a suburb in Phuket with no street address (though not the suburb where the hospital is either).

After sending through more money to cover that (6,000 baht total) with the correct information, which Jason refused to provide me and I still had to go scrounging for myself, the second attempt at a consult was cancelled a couple hours beforehand because, even though all the information was correct, their accounting department doesn't know how to read an international transfer receipt so the last minute consult Jason booked was impossible anyway, because you have to wait two weeks for the money to actually come though. If it comes through, and he hasn't given me the wrong information again.

Despite asking several times, Jason still hasn't given me the correct (or even complete) payment information. This is apparently not an isolated incident with PPSI but is isolated to talking to "Jason" specifically. Pretty sure I'm just going to be left in limbo because there's no way to pay for my consult if the person I'm talking to won't tell me where to send the money.

I would be sure this was a scam if the part where so bad at wasn't specifically the part where they're taking my money.

I have just returned to Perth after having an Endoscopic Brow Lift with Dr Piyapas Pichaichanarong, who is an incredible surgeon. I cannot rate Phuket Plastic Surgery Institute (PPSI) high enough! The team of doctors, nurses and staff members are absolutely incredible, from first point of contact via email in Australia to my last follow up appointment in Phuket two weeks after surgery. Dr Piyapas was very informative, honest and kind, I was a bit nervous about the surgery, but Dr Piyapas, and his Anaesthetist both put me at ease, and they both did a fantastic job before and after surgery. My Anaesthetist was there to wake me up, and managed my pain level straight away back in my private room, along with the lovely nurses who cared for me and checked on me hourly. The level of service at this hospital it unbelievable, the breakfast, lunch and dinners were divine, the food and drinks did not stop coming. Straight after surgery I didn’t look great, my eyes were a bit puffy but I expected worse, and the very next day I looked and felt perfectly fine, to be honest less than a week later you couldn’t even tell. Dr Piyapas, has done an incredible job, I would highly recommend him and his colleagues at PPSI. Also, Phuket is the best place for recovery, not only did I return home looking great with my new brow lift, I had a lovely sun tan, and I also felt mentally calm and relaxed. Thank you to everyone at PPSI.

I recently underwent multiple procedures at PPSI with Dr. Piyapas Pichaichanarong, and I cannot recommend him or the entire team highly enough.

From the moment I met Dr. Piyapas, I felt completely at ease. He was warm, honest, and incredibly thorough. He answered all my questions without sugar-coating anything, which I really appreciated — especially travelling alone for major surgery. What truly blew me away was the extra care he showed — knowing I'd had gastric sleeve surgery and needed extra protein for healing, he personally brought me a banana protein shake every day. That simple gesture meant so much and showed how genuinely he cares for his patients.

I had quite an extensive list of procedures done:
✔️ Breast Reduction with Implants
✔️ Vaser Liposuction (Upper & Lower Abdomen, Love Handles, Lower Back)
✔️ Extended Tummy Tuck & Flankplasty (Belt Lipectomy)
✔️ Vaser Liposuction of the Circumferential Thighs (Inner, Outer, and Front Thighs)
✔️ Extended Thigh Lift

They were big surgeries, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. Even my GP back home was seriously impressed with Dr. Piyapas' work — so much so that he asked for his contact details to refer future patients.

Emotionally, the days after surgery were tough — I was extremely emotional and couldn't stop crying, even though I didn't fully understand why. But the nurses and hospital staff were absolutely incredible. Despite the language barrier, I felt cared for, supported, and safe. They showed me so much kindness and respect, and always empowered me to believe I was improving, even on the tough days.

Every time I went for my check-ups, the staff were genuinely happy to see my progress and mobility improving. It made me feel seen and celebrated.

I also have to give a huge thank you to Restored Beauty Getaways, who organised this for me. From the initial booking to the daily check-ins while I was recovering, they made the entire process so smooth and stress-free. Travelling alone for such a big surgery was daunting, but with their support, I never felt alone. I wouldn’t have had the confidence to do this without them.

If you're considering surgery in Thailand, I honestly couldn’t recommend PPSI, Dr. Piyapas, and Restored Beauty Getaways more. Their care, professionalism, and kindness exceeded all expectations. 10/10 — I wouldn’t trust anyone else.

This place completely ruined my health and mental well-being. I came in for a nasal surgery and was told it would be a “simple, easy recovery.” That was a lie. I suffered for weeks. At first, things were okay, but after two weeks, everything got worse: crusts turned into something like superglue, my nose started clogging again, and breathing became impossible.

When I came back for help, instead of real treatment, they tried to call a “translator” — obviously to charge more money. I refused, and they immediately lost interest in helping me. All they cared about was taking pictures for their Instagram, not actually helping a suffering patient.

I left in worse condition than before the surgery. No proper aftercare, no compassion, just a cold money-grabbing attitude. They wanted me to keep coming and paying again and again while ignoring the worsening symptoms.

Avoid this place at all costs. They don’t care about healing you — only about extracting every cent. I regret ever trusting them.

I'm not usually one to leave reviews, but choosing a place for a procedure is a big decision, so hopefully I can help someone undecided to choose this amazing hospital.

2 weeks ago I flew to Thailand from Australia for a rhinoplasty at PPSI. Absolutely incredible standards, on par with Sydney hospitals. Amazing service from nurses during my stay, my surgeon; Dr. Piyapas Pichaichanarong was very professional and kind. The recovery was very quick and painless, making the surgery feel a lot less invasive than it was. Absolutely every question I had was answered during my consultation, leaving me with no doubts or worries.

Be aware when getting a nose job that the results take around 6 months to fully develop, so don't get discouraged if it is very swollen when the cast first comes off!

My only minor criticism would be the initial difficulty communicating via email. Sometimes it would take a few days to get a reply and have my questions answered. If this was fixed, it would be a lot easier for foreigners looking for cosmetic surgery to be equipped with all the information they need.
Kind, professional, attentive nurses and doctors and amazing results so far, for a quarter of the Australian price.

I am surprised there are not more reviews for PPSI (part of Bangkok hospital), so if anyone has any questions, I can only answer from my personal experience. feel free to reach out! My instagram is saskiafinnan

I made an appointment to see Dr Jib who came highly recommended by friends for a BA revision. On the day of the appointment, I waited for 1.5hrs before seeing Dr Jib. This seems to defeat the purpose of making an appointment and showing up early to register myself.

During the consult, Dr Jib was kind and professional. And recommended Motiva. I left Dr Jib's room and waited another 1hour outside for a quotation. The reception staff provided me with 2 quotes for 2 models. This was not discussed at all with Dr Jib, thus I was taken back. The staff said one is softer than the other. But I wanted Dr Jib's recommendation since this is a BA revision. If he had mentioned 2 different models during the consult, I would have asked more questions then.

This discussion with the reception staff went on for about 10 mins, and I was uncomfortable with this. It would have been better if they took me into a room to discuss the quote, rather than just hand me a piece of paper after paying for the consult. There was also no discussion about possible schedule for the surgery when I specifically asked Dr Jib about his schedule.

I wanted to discuss about the different models with Dr Jib but he was already with another patient. So I asked if I can send Dr Jib and email or via other communication methods. They say he does not reply to emails or any other communication channels! But I can write in to their general enquiry email address.

I did write in that very same day with about 6-7 questions but failed to get a response after 5 days. So I called in and was transferred to a Jason. He managed to send me a reply a few days later but only replied to one of my questions. I wrote back at once asking for more answers but they have gone silent for the last 10 days or so. I called 2 days ago to reach Jason since he is the gatekeeper, left my name and number, but so far no reply.

I am floored that the surgeon does not reply to questions. The procedures may be routine to him but it is a big surgery to me. So questions are normal. And I am put off that he is so unreachable with gatekeepers protecting him like a god.

At the end of the day, the prices are the same as in Singapore. I might as well go to Singapore for the procedure. The surgeon and his team there are also so much more responsive and caring.

Came here the first time for consultation after doing some google research. But google research won’t be enough because thai people don’t really use google and not all the people that came here did the reviews.

So I’m going to tell you what to do. Book an online appointment (consultation or surgery) or make a call to the PPSI (Phuket Plastic Surgery Institute). They’ll tell you what to do, when to come, and approximation of the fees. Go here as scheduled.

Though the PPSI personnel are able to speak English fluently the other staff here don’t. Go straight to 4th floor (PPSI floor) and do what you need to do here.

If you don’t know how to get here in the first place, take Local Bus Line 1 from Bus Terminal 1 (Pink bus with number 1 on it) 15 TB/person and asked for Big C as destination, PPSI just next to it. If you want to leave after surgery I suggest you book a rental car. If not you can take Local Bus Line 1 again to Bus Terminal 1.
